9:55.text: So let not their wealth nor their children amaze you
; in reality Allâh’s Plan is to punish them with these things in the life of this world, and that their souls shall depart

9:56.text: They swear by Allâh that they are truly of you while they are not of you, but they are a people

9:57.text: Should they find a refuge, or caves, or a place of concealment, they would turn straightway thereto with a swift rush.

9:58.text: And of them are some who accuse you
the alms. If they are given part thereof, they are pleased, but if they are not given thereof, behold! They are enraged!

9:59.text: Would that they were contented with what Allâh and His Messenger
gave them and had said: "Allâh is Sufficient for us. Allâh will give us of His Bounty, and so will His Messenger

9:60.text: , and to attract the hearts of those who have been inclined
, and to free the captives, and for those in debt, and for Allâh’s Cause
(i.e. for Mujahidûn - those fighting in a holy battle)
(a traveller who is cut off from everything)
; a duty imposed by Allâh. And Allâh is All-Knower, All-Wise.
